Food

What comes off the grill

From the menu and from what guests write in their Google reviews.

On real charcoal

Pork and chicken souvlaki, freshly prepared and grilled on charcoal, as guests describe it.

Sheftalia the old way

Guests write that the sheftalia are the traditional kind, not full of breadcrumbs like in many other places.

Take away or stay

Mostly a take away, with a few tables outside if you want to eat right away.

Cooked to order

Everything is cooked to order. One guest writes the order was ready in 20 minutes, at busy times it takes longer, so call ahead.

How guests describe it

Taken from what guests write in their Google reviews.

Big portions

Guests write about generous portions at a good price, one says the portion was bigger than a plate.

Fresh salad

Regulars

One guest has been coming since childhood, another drives 15 minutes for it and calls it the best take away souvlaki place.

A souvlaki shop on Faneromeni

Green Corner is a small souvlaki shop on Faneromeni 212 in Larnaca, near the little church of Saint George. The meat goes on the charcoal, into Cypriot pita with fresh salad, and out in a paper bag with the green Green Corner print.

What guests say

Three of 205 Google reviews, all three with five stars.

“The best Souvlakia in Cyprus without doubt. Lean tender meat, tasty sheftalies, fresh veg and freshly cut proper chips too. Don't waste your time and money going to restaurants for souvlakia when you can eat in here or take it home. Nothing compares.”

Google review
“Excellent quality kebabs, tender pork and also top quality, traditional style Sheftalies unlike those in many other places that are full of bread crumbs. Portion size is large.”

Google review
“I've been coming to this Souvlakia shop since I was a child, their quality and quantity of food is great and so is their service. Their prices are very decent and affordable and their menu is flexible to satisfy customers preferences.”
